To: All Team Members

From: [Your Name]

Subject: Clarification on the Reporting Process

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to provide a brief clarification on our current reporting process to ensure everyone is on the same page.

For all monthly reports, please submit them by the 15th of each month. To do so, please log into our company portal, navigate to the 'Reports' section, and upload your completed report
